extracted.name: How to Cook Bulgur Wheat
extracted.description: This simple recipe is my favorite method for cooking coarse bulgur wheat. Chewy and nutty, the cooked bulgur is delicious in salads, grain bowls, and more!
instruction_lines: Bring the water to a boil in a small or medium pot over high heat.
Stir in the bulgur, cover, turn off the heat, and set aside for 20 to 30 minutes, or until tender. Drain excess water. Fluff with a fork.
